long_description:
Gather your family, colleagues and friends and catch the Wellington Lions at Hnry Stadium - all from the comfort of our Members Club.

id: Propagandhi tickets-Meow Nui, Wellington, New Zealand-Ticketek
name: Propagandhi tickets
long_description:
Presented by: SBM
Propagandhi will make their long-awaited return to Australia and Aotearoa in early 2027, marking their first shows in the region in nearly eight years.
The ever-evolving standard-bearers of politically charged punk have actively kicked against musical confines and bro-punk conservatism, promoting a message of anti-fascism since 1986. Distilling their DNA of breakneck riffs, hardcore ethos, and radical consciousness, their message remains as vital, and volatile, as ever.
The tour comes in support of the Manitoba, Canada-based outfit’s eighth album, *At Peace*. In true Propagandhi fashion, it’s smart music for dangerous times. “Everything I’m singing about is still coming from being the same person that wrote and sang our first record *How to Clean Everything* in 1993,” Chris Hannah states, recalling the band’s snarky skate-thrash origins.
“But what we’re putting into the songs now, probably reflects more despair than 30 years ago when we had similar perspectives, but with strands of hope and naivete. Now it’s the existential dread of eking out a life worth living in this completely failed society.”
Propagandhi are set to bring their incendiary live show back to Australia and Aotearoa, drawing from a body of work that continues to challenge, confront, and inspire.
New album "At Peace" out now Propagandhi.com

name: Flamingo Pier (LIVE) tickets
long_description:
Presented by: Banished Music & Lacuna
After more than a decade of building dancefloors around the world, Flamingo Pier return home this spring to celebrate the release of their new album, WOVEN TOGETHER, with a six-date New Zealand tour.
Don't miss the chance to experience WOVEN TOGETHER live, as Flamingo Pier bring their full live band to the stage for a euphoric celebration of connection, community and irresistible grooves. Expect an immersive live show filled with new music, fan favourites, and the infectious energy that has made Flamingo Pier one of Aotearoa's most beloved dance acts, with some very special guests along the way.
Funded through NZ On Air and supported by the NZ Music Commission.

id: Hnry Stadium Car Parking-Hnry Stadium Car Park, Wellington, New Zealand-Ticketek
name: Hnry Stadium Car Parking
venue: Hnry Stadium Car Park, Wellington, New Zealand
long_description:
Get your event day car park sorted in advance for the System of a Down concert at Hnry Stadium. With limited car parking in the CBD, this is the best way to secure your spot and avoid missing out, especially if you are coming from out of town.
If you require a mobility car park space, please complete the online form here.
Online parking sales close one hour prior to the car park open time.

Car parking EZY tickets will need to be printed and be ready to show on your arrival to the car park. Once parked, please display clearly on your dashboard.
Standard size vehicles only up to 2m wide x 5.4m long x 2.2m high. Larger vehicles may be turned away at the owners' risk. Please contact Hnry Stadium in advance should you wish to bring a large vehicle.

id: Timmy Regisford tickets-Meow Nui, Wellington, New Zealand-Ticketek
name: Timmy Regisford tickets
long_description:
Presented by: Bench Music and TEG Touring
Few figures have shaped the sound and spirit of house music like Timmy Regisford.
From New York's legendary WBLS radio station to executive A&R roles at Atlantic, MCA, Motown and DreamWorks Records, Regisford has spent more than four decades helping define dance music from both behind the scenes and behind the decks.
As founder and resident of the iconic Club Shelter, Timmy created one of dance music's most influential institutions - a sanctuary built on soulful house, disco, Afro rhythms, jazz, gospel and community that continues to inspire DJs and dancers around the world.
Known for marathon sets that unfold over many hours, Timmy's performances are journeys through rhythm, emotion and timeless music rather than peak-time moments. His influence stretches across generations, remaining just as essential to young selectors discovering the roots of house as it is to those who experienced New York's golden era firsthand.
